name: no-silent-assumptions
description: Blocks turns that end on unsurfaced guesses. A skill for tracking the assumptions you make while working — environment, data shape, API behavior, edge cases — and a Stop hook that detects assumption-laden language in code added this turn, refusing 'done' until they're surfaced in an 'Assumptions:' block or marked NO-SILENT-ASSUMPTIONS: INTENTIONAL. Conservative on purpose: only guess-shaped phrases fire, never bare words.
